items.headline: Planning Commission to weigh Peery Park expansion plan
items.summary: The Planning Commission is scheduled to hold a study session and scoping meeting on a proposed amendment to the Peery Park Specific Plan that would increase allowed office and R&D square footage and residential units, and relocate the Libby Water Tower. The meeting will also take public comment on the scope of a Supplemental Environmental Impact Report to the plan's 2016 EIR.

items.headline: Council interviewed city attorney candidates in closed session
items.summary: The October 9 agenda listed a closed session for the City Council to interview candidates for City Attorney, indicating the city is in the process of filling that top legal post.

items.headline: Council agenda covered city attorney transition, pay raises
items.summary: The October 6 agenda listed discussion of temporary legal services during a city attorney transition, compensation changes for unrepresented confidential and management employees, and a market adjustment to the city manager's salary.

items.headline: 372-unit apartment building permitted on Yoshino Way
items.summary: A new apartment building with 372 dwelling units received a building permit at 120 Yoshino Way, with a declared permit valuation of $66,319,496. A companion permit for the project's parking garage, valued at $27,952,287, was issued the same day.

items.headline: Chabad use permit request listed for zoning hearing
items.summary: A Zoning Administrator hearing agenda for September 30 listed a use permit request to allow a religious institution use at 645 W. Fremont Avenue, an existing commercial building owned by Chabad of Sunnyvale, in an R-1 zoning district.
